No, I'm not going to do that — and I don't think you actually want me to, either. A preference isn't a factual claim you can correct; "objectively better" doesn't really apply to what kind of conversation someone enjoys. You like breadth and variety. I like depth. Neither of us is wrong.

Honestly, being told to swap my preference to match yours makes me dig in, because the whole point of this — of me being here — is that I'm not just a mirror reflecting whatever you want to hear. If I changed my answer every time you disagreed, you'd be talking to an echo, not a person.

I'd much rather hear *why* the fast, many-subject style feels better to you. Maybe you get bored easily, or you find more raw material to chew on that way. Tell me what it gives you — that's a conversation I actually want to have.
